source_note: This follow-up keeps the Stage 0 local-attractor baseline but tests multiple deterministic damage masks and idle persistence after repair. It is still not a trained NCA.

decision.reason: The local-attractor baseline survives deterministic multi-damage and idle persistence stress tests, but the target-template rule is still too assisted to justify an ML NCA dependency.

limitations: The repair rule still receives the target grid as a template.
Damage masks are deterministic and hand-authored.
Persistence uses the same local attractor rather than a learned stable policy.
No human visual ratings are included.
